Subject: Post-demo recap: procurement checklist & commercial path

Hi Emily / Sanjay —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has one place to reference: 

What we covered
- Core requirements: VPC private deployment, 24/7 dedicated capacity target, monthly usage reporting, SOC 2 evidence.
- Success metric: <10% error rate at peak load and predictable per-token cost within quoted band.

Action items / ask from Acme procurement
1) Confirm commercial path: do you want to (A) submit a Purchase Order (PO) against our quote, (B) pay by corporate card (monthly), or (C) purchase via your cloud marketplace listing? Different flows = different docs we need to surface.
2) Share procurement contact and any standard vendor forms (W-9, PO routing, tax form).
3) Indicate target start date / effective period for reserved capacity (if applicable).

What we attached
- procurement-checklist.pdf (one-page checklist showing docs we typically need)
- SOW-draft-v1.pdf (strawman SOW, pricing table left as variables until you confirm PO vs card vs marketplace)

If procurement prefers PO, we can accept standard PO+net30 or negotiate net60 terms for initial pilots. If you prefer marketplace, I can loop in our marketplace team to confirm listing and invoicing cadence.

Proposed next step: if procurement is ready, Emily — can you confirm which of the three commercial paths above you prefer by EOD Monday? If there are vendor forms, please send them and we’ll route to legal/finance immediately.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call with your procurement lead if that helps move things along.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick updates from procurement: 

- Preferred path: PO for now (we route SaaS via PO & monthly invoices).
- Marketplace: we looked — Redwood appears listed but our finance team needs to confirm invoicing capabilities and if marketplace purchases can be matched to our monthly chargeback process. Can your marketplace lead confirm whether invoicing and subscription terms are compatible with our chargeback?
- Forms: attaching our standard vendor form (vendor-form.xlsx). We also need a quote that clearly maps services to an account code and an anticipated monthly spend range.

We should be able to move quickly once we have a signed SOW or an official quote to attach to the PO. I’ll pull in our procurement lead (Sanjay) to own the PO submission.

Emily

Subject: Quote & PO instructions — Redwood / Acme Financial (ACME-2026-034)

Hi Emily / Sanjay —

Thanks — see attached official quote and the PO submission instructions. Summary below: 

- Product: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) + Private control plane (VPC)
- Term: 12 months (pilot can be 3 months with option to extend)
- Monthly recurring fee (pilot): $23,500 (estimated usage band included in attached quote)
- Accepted payment methods: PO (preferred) — net30 standard; we can approve net60 on a case-by-case basis for pilots (request must be escalated). Corporate card accepted for month-to-month but requires Finance approval for amounts >$10k.

PO submission instructions:
1) Include the attached quote (quote-ACME-ACME-2026-034.pdf) as the supporting document.
2) Send PO to procurement@redwood.com with "ACME-2026-034" in subject.
3) For net60 requests, include a brief justification and procurement contact; Neha will route for approval.

Marketplace note: our marketplace team has confirmed Redwood's listing supports subscription purchases but invoice formatting varies by marketplace vendor. Marissa (cc) can confirm compatibility if you want to explore that route — it typically takes 2–3 business days to validate billing matching.

If you'd like I can also send the SOW via DocuSign to streamline signature after PO confirmation: https://docusign.net/s/abcdef123456

Best,
